prompt: Vertical advertising poster for a Vietnamese agricultural product. A smiling Vietnamese farmer wearing a conical hat crouches in a lush green field and holds the product package labeled '{TenSanPham}' toward the camera. Bright warm sunlight, blue sky, fresh green and yellow colors, a modern greenhouse and an agricultural drone in the background. Large bold Vietnamese headline at the top: '{TieuDe}'. A clean ribbon below with the benefits: '{LoiIch}'. Professional commercial photography, sharp product details, premium social-media advertising design.
